usage: Steamed pork ribs are a common noun and usually refer to a dish served in dim sum restaurants.
You can use steamed pork ribs as the subject or object in a sentence, for example, 'I like steamed pork ribs' or 'Steamed pork ribs are delicious.'
When ordering food, you can simply say the name of the dish, like 'Steamed pork ribs, please.'
The phrase 'steamed pork ribs' can be combined with verbs like 'eat', 'order', or 'make' depending on the context.
It is common to describe the dish by adding adjectives related to taste or texture, e.g., 'tasty steamed pork ribs' or 'spicy steamed pork ribs.'
